ModMetaData.name: Unburned + Do Not Avoid Fire 性能修复 / Performance Fix
ModMetaData.author: WhiteGiverMa
ModMetaData.description:
优化无火与局部火灾中的待命扫描，修复密封装备缓存；加载 Do Not Avoid Fire 时，同时修复 1.7 寻路缓存、危险成本与原生内存生命周期。
Optimizes idle scans on peaceful and burning maps, replaces the sealed-apparel cache, and repairs Do Not Avoid Fire's optional 1.7 path-grid integration, danger costs and native buffer lifetime.
